meta.name: Ata Demirer Gazinosu
meta.description: Demirer performs stand-up comedy and acts as a "one-man cabaret"! The successful comedian has a wide repertoire ranging from Turkish classical music to opera, folk music to pop and arabesque. Demirer is accompanied on stage by an orchestra conducted by Taşkın Sabah and, from time to time, dancers. The humor-filled stories that the audience eagerly awaits also take their place on stage between songs. Ata Demirer, with his unique style, both makes the audience laugh with his jokes and brings a pleasant sound to the theater stage with his songs.
